definition: I. [ שָׁבַח ] verb Pi`el soothe, still (Arabic be free from care , etc., Jen ZA 1 (1886),188 ;iv (1889),269, compare Assyrian pašâ—u , grow calm , so Ba ES9 Schulth Lex .); — Pi`el Imperfect 3 masculine singular sf יְשַׁבְּחֶ֑נָּה Prov 29:11 he stilleth it , i.e. רוּחוֺ his temper ( Bi Toy read חָשַׁךְ אַפּוֺ ); 2 masculine singular sf תְּשַׁבְּחֵם Ps 89:10 thou stillest them , i.e. waves (|| גֵּאוּת הַיָּם ). Hiph`il Participle (probably Masoretic error for Pi`el מְשַׁבֵּחַ ) מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֺן יַמִּים Ps 65:8 stilling the roar of the seas.
